title: Roles and teams
intro: A role is a set of permissions; every account has one. Teams group people, and a role in a team counts for its sub-teams too. Accounts themselves are on the Users page.
deleteRoleQuestion: Remove the role {{role}}? Only works when no account has it.
teamsIntro: A lead of Infra also leads Core, Access and Wi-Fi. A team role only counts inside the team: what someone may do everywhere comes from their own role.
deleteTeamQuestion: Remove the team {{team}}? Its members leave it; sub-teams must be moved or removed first.

roleText.admin: Everything, including settings, accounts, plugins and roles.
roleText.lead: Everything a tech can, plus the floor plan, assigning incidents to any team and reading the audit log.
roleText.tech: Works incidents for their teams, runs port actions, sees seat and network data.
roleText.viewer: Looks at the floor plan and dashboards, changes nothing.
roleText.kiosk: A read-only account for a big screen. Remove it to revoke it.

permission.floorplan_view: See the floor plan, dashboards and live switch status
permission.floorplan_edit: Change the floor plan and the inventory, run syncs
permission.seats_view: See who sits where: nicks, IPs, MACs and check-ins
permission.seats_edit: Change the seat mapping and check-ins
permission.incidents_work: Work incidents assigned to their teams
permission.ports_act: Run port actions and show commands on switches
permission.commands_change: Run switch commands that change something, such as clearing counters
permission.terminal_open: Open a terminal on a switch in the browser, with their own switch login
permission.power_edit: Change power boards and circuits, enter readings and trips
